tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rgyal ba'i sku gzugs kyi cha tshad bstan pa bde skyid 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ rgyal ba'i sku gzugs kyi cha tshad bstan pa bde skyid 'byung gnas zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phun tshogs dge legs kun gyi gzhir gyur pa/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas la phyag 'tshal nas/ /sku gzugs cha tshad rnam par dbye ba gang*/ /mdo rgyud rnams las legs gsungs mdo tsam bri/ /de ltar yang dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi bshad rgyud sdom pa 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i le'u sum cu pa las 'di skad ces gsungs te/ lha yi ri mo gzugs dag gi khyon dang gzugs kyi mtshan nyid do/ /tshangs pa'i ri mo gzugs kyi : sngar £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡· sngags/ / £© cha lnga dag ni gdan yin no/ /sku ni dum bu gsum can gyi/ /zhal dang snyan dang phrag pa'o/ /zhal ni bcu gnyis cha dag gi /sor mo bzhi ni mgrin pa'o/ /dbu dang skra mtshams de nyid ltar/ /snyan gnyis dag la'o legs par mtshan/ /dpral ba shangs dang zhal rnams kyis/ /gdong ni cha gsum rnams kyi ste/ /smin ma'i mtha' dang zhal steng gi / spyan ni sor gnyis dag gis so/ /de dag gis ni dkyus kyi tshad/ /sor mo bzhi ru bcad pa'o/ / dbus kyi mgrin pa zhes dbus kyis/ /nor lha'i cha las thal mo gnyis/ /snying ga dang ni lte ba'i gnas/ /thal mo gcig ces thams cad do/ /nu ma'i bar ni thal mo ste/ nu ma dag las brang mthil bzhin/ /phyag ni thal mo gsum pa ste/ / 'di'i phyag mgo gnyis thal mo/ /sor mo bzhi dang ldan pa yi/ /brla dang byin pa yang dag ldan/ /cha shas sor mo bzhi yin te/ /de bzhin nyid du zhabs thal mo/ /mthil dang thal mo bcu gnyis kyi/ /lha yi gzugs ni bri ba la/ /sor mo bzhi yi lhag ma ni/ /gdan ni sor mo brgyad kyis so/ /gdan dang gdan gyi 'brel ba yis/ /gnyis kyi sor dang sor mo'o/ /snying po zla ba'i dkyil 'khor te/ /mtshon cha na bza' la sogs bya/ /zab mo rdo rje'i lha dag ni/ /thal mo bcu gnyis mtshan nyid do/ /dma' pa'i cha la sogs pa'i cha/

/nye bar mdzes shing mdzes pa bri/ /de yang khyon ni thal mo ste/ /phyag gnyis dag ni mtshungs pa yis/ /spang bar bya ba sor mo gnyis/ /zhi ba'i lha ni bri ba la'o/ /rtag tu gsus pa dga' bar bya/ /dor bar bya ba sor mo gnyis/ / mtshams dang mtshams la thams cad du/ khro bo khro mo dbang lha mo/ /bran dang bran ni ci bgyi ma/ /drag cing 'jigs su rung ba'i gzugs/ /thal mo bcur ni mngon par bri/ /gzugs mdzes yid du 'ong ba ni/ /thal mo dgu par mngon par bri/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ mdzes shing nye bar mdzes pa bri/ /zhes pa'i rgyas bshad du/ ring ba gsum ni skyon che ste/ /os ko mgrin pa byin pa'o/ /sna dang rna ba sor mo sogs/ /gsum po thung ba nyes pa che/ /byin pa zhabs sogs mkhur ba dag /gsum po sbom pa skyon chen te/ /'gram pa brang dang rtsib logs gsum/ /zhom pa nyes pa chen po'o/ /nu ma rna ba dpral ba gsum/ /mkhyog pa nyes pa chen po ste/ /brla dang dku dang nang tshoms gnyis/ /gsum po zhom pa skyon che'o/ /mig g.yon sna dang rna ba dang*/ /mchu dang dpral ba dag nyams na/ /zhes sogs dang*/ rgyab yol dang ni gdugs dang gdan/ /gsum po chung zhing dog pa'i skyon/ /zhes kyang gsungs la/ de bzhin du/ mtshan nyid thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ /gzugs mdzes cho ga mthong ba ste/ /zhi ba la ni zhi ba'i gzugs/ /drag cing 'jigs rung drag po ste/ /dpa' zhing nga rgyal sku dpa' bo/ /bzhad pa'i zhal ni sgeg pa ste/ / zhes gsungs so/ /de la tshig rkang dang po gnyis mdor bstan te/ khyon zhes bya ba ni dkyus dang zheng ngo*/ /tshangs pa'i ri mo ni/ tshangs thig ste/ sku gzugs 'dri ba'i sngon la 'debs dgos zhes pa yin no/ /cha lnga gdan zhes pa ni/ sku gzugs bzhugs pa rnams kyi dbang du byas pa'i gdan gyi chung mtha' bshad pa yin la/ sku dum bu gsum zhes bya ba ni/ gtsug tor nas lkog ma'i mtha' dang*/ de nas brang zhol gyi mtha' dang*/

de nas gsang ba'i bar cha mnyam pa'o/ /zhal dang mnyam pa phrag pa zhes pa ni/ mgrin pa'i mas sna nas g.yas g.yon du dpung pa'i rtse mo'i bar la/ zhal ras kyi khyon dang mnyam pa'i tshad ces pa ste rags rtsis so/ /zhal gang gi bcu gnyis cha la sor zhes bya ste/ mgrin pa dang thod dpangs dang*/ snyan gyi dkyus dang*/ dpral ba dang shangs dang*/ zhal gyi sa rnams ni sor bzhi'o/ /zhal rnams kyi zhes pa'i skabs 'dir zhal zhes bya ba ni kha te/ zhal gyi sa ni sna rtse'i 'og nas skos sko'i rtse mo'i bar ro/ /dbu dang skra mtshams zhes bya ba'i don ni/ dbu dang skra'i gnas zhes sgyur te/ dbu'i gnas sam skra'i gnas ni/ thod ngas dpangs yin la/ bod skad dang bstun na/ dbu'i skra mtshams sam dbu'i skra gnas zhes sgyur na legs so/ /spyan gyi zheng ni sor gnyis zhes bshad pa/ smin ma'i mtha' te smin rus kyi 'og dang*/ zhal ras te mkhur tshos kyi rus pa'i steng du zhais pa ste/ de gnyis kyi bar yas byibs kyi zheng rags rtsis su ston pa yin gyi/ spyan gdangs pa'i bar gyi zheng ston pa ma yin no/ /smin ma'i mtha' zhes pa'i mtha' ni 'og gi mtha' yin la/ smin ma dang spyan de dag gi dkyus ni sor bzhi'o/ /dbus kyi mgrin pa zhais dbus kyi zhais pa ni/ mgrin pa'i mthil gyi dbus nas ni zhes bsgyur na bde ste/ mthil dang dbus skad dod gcig cing*/ mthil gyi don yang*/ sa gzhi dma' ba la sa mthil zhes brjod pa ltar 'og gi cha'i ming ngo*/ /nor lha ni brgyad de mgrin pa lus ma gzhi dang 'brel mtshams kyi sbom sar dbus nas phyed gshags su gzhal na cha chung brgyad yod do zhes pa'i don no/ /de bzhin du thal mo gnyis ni rim pa bzhin/ mgrin pa nas snying kha'i bar dang snying ga nas lte ba'i bar ro/ / thams cad ces pa ni gsang ba ste/ lte ba nas de'i bar la'ang thal mo gcig go /nu ma gnyis kyi sa gzhi'i bar ni/ thal mo gnyis te nu ma las g.yas g.yon du brang gi mthil dang mnyam par thal mo re res gzhal ba ni/

rags par na rtsib logs kyi tshad yin pas g.yas g.yon du/ rgyab kyi rus pa la reg par 'gyur ro zhes dgongs so/ /dpung pa'i tshigs nas 'khrig ma'i bar du phyag thal mo gsum gyi tshad yin la/ phyag mgo yang thal mo gcig yin no/ /pus mo'i mtshams su sor mo bzhi dang ldan pa byas nas/ de bor ba'i lhag ma brla dang byin pa sdoms pa yang*/ phyag dang ring thung mnyam par ldan pa'i don te/ phyag la zhal tshad bzhi yod pa bzhin du/ brla la gnyis dang*/ byin pa la gnyis yod pa sdoms na yang bzhi yod pas so/ /cha shas sor mo bzhi zhes pa ni gsang ba'i yas mtha' na brla'i bar la/ sor bzhi'i sa yod pa la/ dbus su gsang gnas kyi dbyibs dang*/ g.yas g.yon du dpyi mtshams 'byung ba'i gnas so/ / 'di ni dbus su sku gzugs ma mo'i cha shas dang*/ g.yas g.yon du zhabs kyi cha shas yod pas cha shas zhes btags so/ /de bzhin nyid du zhabs zhes pas/ long bu'i tshigs mtshams nas bcal na zhabs mgo'i spangs la sor bzhi yin la/ zhabs thal mo zhais pa ni zhabs mthil gyi dkyus tshad ston pa ste/ rting pa'i phyogs sor gnyis 'phags pa yin la/ rting pa dor ba'i thal mo'o zhes kha cig bzhed la/ gzhan dag sor mo mi the ba'i dbang du byas so zhes bzhed pa gnyis ka dus 'khor dang bstun par snang ba 'dod pa gnyis po dag gi phyi ma legs la/ 'on kyang 'di ni zhabs mgo'i dkyus yongs rdzogs so/ /rting pa sor bzhi phyir 'phags par gzhan las bshad pa ni segs la yod pa'i dbang du byas la/ zhabs mthil gyi ngos nas brtsams na sor gnyis yin cing*/ 'on kyang sor mo brgya nyi shu pa'i phyogs la sor gnyis su ma longs tsam gyi tshad du byas na legs par mngon no/ /de yan chad cha tshad spyi ldog nas bshad pa yin la/ mthil dang thal mo bcu gnyis kyi zhes pa nas/ nye bar mdzes shing mdzes pa bri/ /zhes pa'i bar ni gdan dang thor tshugs kyang bsnan pa'i dbang du byas nas thal mo bcu gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid ston byed do/

/'di yang lo ngo lo grangs su rtsis pa dang 'dra ba'i rnam grangs tsam gyi sgo nas bshad pa yin gyi/ yang dag par na gdan dang thor tshugs sbrags pa la thal mo bcu gcig dang sor brgyad ring mtha' yin no/ /sor mo bzhi sogs ni/ sor mo bzhi yis lhag pa yi/ /sor mo brgyad ni gdan yin no/ /zhes bsgyur na bde ste/ sor brgyad 'jigs byed dus mtshan sogs ro gdan gyi dpangs dang sor bzhi pad nyi'o/ /gdan dang sogs kyi don ni gdan dngos nyi gdan dang padma'i ge sar sbrags pa la sor gnyis dang*/ padma'i 'dab ma la sor gnyis kyi dpangs so/ /snying po zla ba'i dkyil 'khor zhes pa ni/ nyi ma la yang 'dra ste/ nyi zla gang rung dang padma'i snying po ste ge sar la sor re re zhes pa'i don te/ rgyud 'di las/ dngos bstan la thor tshugs kyi tshad gsal bar ma gsungs so/ /pad nyi'i gdan gyi dpangs ni/ chung mtha' nas tshad bzung ba yin pas/ 'di bas kyang che ba byar rung ngo*/ /zab mo rdo rje'i lha zhes bya ba ni sngags kyi dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rnams so/ /des na rgyud 'di'i dngos bstan la/ sor mo brgya nyi shu pa'i lha nyid gtso bor gsungs pa yin gyi/ brgya nyer lnga pa gsungs pa med do/ /dma' ba'i cha la sogs pa zhais pa ni/ dma' ba dang mtho ba phra ba dang sbaum pa sogs te mdor na go ba chags pas don dang mthun pa'i ka ba skyed gtong ba dang*/ grims lhod dang 'gying khugs sogs shin tu nyams dod par bya'o zhais pa'i don no/ /phyag gnyis dag ni sogs phyag g.yas g.yon gnyis la sngar gyi tshad las sor mo gnyis gnyis phri ba dang*/ de yang thal mo zhes sogs la gsungs pa dga' ba ni gsus pa 'phyang ba'i rgyas pa'o/ /dor bar bya ba sor mo gnyis zhes pa gsus pa'i mtshams su yang sor gnyis phri'o/ /zhes pa'i tshig tu snang bas/ sor mo brgya nyi shu pa las phri nas zhi ba la sor brgya rtsa brgyad pa dang*/ khro bo la sor dgu bcu rtsa drug pa ston byed yin par mngon te/

'brid 'bri tshul phyogs mtshon tsam gsungs pa yin no/ /de las gzhan du spangs bar bya ba sor mo gnyis zhes dang dor bar bya ba sor mo gnyis zhes sogs kyis sor brgya nyer lnga pa nas brgya nyi shu par ji ltar 'bri ba'i tshul ston pa yin na/ 'og tu thal mo bcu pa dang thal mo dgu par 'bri zhes pa tsam las/ ji ltar 'dri ba'i tshul ma bstan par 'gyur ro/ /des na/ de yang khyon ni thal mo ste zhes sogs sho lo ka gcig dang*/ gzugs mdzes yid du 'ong ba ni/ thal mo dgu par mngon par 'dri/ zhes pa sbyar nas zhi ba 'ga' zhig dang*/ yid tsam khro ba la sogs pa rnams dang*/ de yang thal mo zhal byas nas zhes sogs sho lo ka gnyis kyis ches khros pa drag po'i sku'i mtshan nyin bshad la/ 'dir khro bo khro mo zhal tshad mnyam par bshad pas/ sems dpa' yab yum yang zhal tshad 'dra bar rigs pa dang*/ gzugs mdzes yid du 'ong ba ni/ zhes pa 'di zhi ba pho la'ang tshang dgos pas/ lha mo kho na la mi gzung ste/ de ltar na mdzes pa'i mthar thug dang yid du 'ong shos sor brgya nyer lnga pa dang nyi shu pa yin kyang*/ 'dir mdzes pa smos pa ni thal mo brgyad pa sogs mi sdug pa shas che ba yin pas/ zhi ba 'ga' zhig dang rol pa'i khro bo mdzes cha che ba byed na dgu pa las thung ba mi rung ngo zhes go ba'i phyir ro/ /de yang khyon ni thal mo ste zhais pa dang*/ de yang thal mo zhal byas te zhais pa'i don ni/ rang rang gi lus kyi brgyad cha dang dgu cha la zhal gyi tha snyad du bzhag ces pa'i don yin la/ mtshams dang mtshams la thams cad du/ zhais pa ni sngar gyi cha tshad kyi steng nas/ sku'i cha so so'i mtshams thams cad nas phri te bri bar bya zhes pa spyir stangs mdor bstan yin gyi/ so so'i nges bzung rnams skabs 'dir gsal bar ma bstan to/ /des na ri mo mkhan tshugs sbyong ba la/ tshad gsum po de dag lha rigs so so la sbyor na ni/ he ru ka la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa khro bo rnams dang*/

sangs rgyas spyan ma la sogs pa de bzhin bshegs ma rnams kyang de bzhin gshegs pa zhi ba rnams dang rags tshad phal cher 'dra bas/ zheng du sor brgya nyi shu pa dang*/ rdo rje khro mo rnams kyang rdo rje khro bo bzhin du sor dgu bcu go drug pa dang*/ rol pa'i khro mo phal pa dang*/ byang chub sems ma rnams kyang*/ rol pa'i khro bo phal pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams bzhin du/ sor brgya nyi shu pa nas sor brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i bar ji ltar 'os 'os su sbyar na don dang mi 'gal zhing rnam grangs tsam du legs par 'gyur mod/ spyir ni so so la mi sbyor bar zhi ba rnams thal mo bcu pa'am thal mo dgu pa gang rung 'bri la/ mi'u thung gi rnam pa ma yin pa'i khro bo rnams kyang*/ thal mo bcu pa nas brgyad pa'i bar gang yang rung bar bri bar bya'o/ /zhes pa ni rgyud kyi dgongs don no/ /gdan bzhi'i bshad rgyud mand+ra aṃ sa las gsungs pa'ang 'gyur khyad ma gtogs phal cher 'di dang 'dra la/ zhal tshad dgu pa gsal por ma gsungs so/ /skabs 'dir dpyad par bya ba'i gnas ni sdom 'byung gi 'brel pa padma can zhes bya ba slob dpon ratna rakṣi tas mdzad pa las ni/ cha lnga dag ni gdan zhes pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon brkyang gi stabs kho na la 'chad pa dang*/ dum bu gsum can zhes pa'ang 'gying sum 'khyogs la 'chad pa dang*/ zhal dang mnyam pa'i phrag pa zhes pa/ zhal dang phrag pa gnyis la yang zhes ston nas/ 'gying de'i rnam 'gyur du 'chad pa dang*/ thal mo bcu gnyis sa bcu gnyis rnam par dag pa dang*/ gdan dang gdan gyi 'brel ba zhes pa'i don gyi rnam grangs gcig la/ ral pa'i cod pan du 'chad pa dang*/ snying por zla ba'i dkyil 'khor zhes pa zla phyed la 'chad pa dang*/ dbu dang skra mtshams de nyid ltar zhes sogs la/ dus 'khor nas gsungs pa ltar sor phyed bcu po bsnon pa'i lugs mdzad pa dang*/ de bzhin nyid du zhabs thal mo zhes pa yan chad/

sangs rgyas chags bral gyi cha lugs can dang*/ 'khor los sgyur ba dang*/ he ru ka sogs thams cad kyi spyi'i mtshan nyid ston byed du mi mdzad par/ he ru ka'i rigs kho na la sbyor ba dang*/ de yang khyon ni thal mo ste sogs sor brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga pa'i lha las/ sor phyed bcu spong tshul bstan pas/ sor brgya nyi shu pa ston gsung ba dang*/ thal mo dgu pa ni lha mo kho na yin cing*/ lha mo zhi ba yin phyin cha tshad gcig kho nar byas pas/ de bzhin gshegs ma dang byang chub sems ma la khyad par med par bzhed pa dang*/ nye bar mdzes shing mdzes pa bri/ zhes pa yan chad kyi gzhung rnams sor brgya nyer lnga pa kho nar skyogs bshad mdzad pa rnams ni/ spyir ri mo mkhan lag len byed pa'i skabs su 'gal ba cher med pa srid na'ang*/ rgyud kyi gzhung don la zhugs pa'i bshad par ye mi snang ngo*/ /'grel pa de'i nag 'byams kyi skabs su/ sor brgya nyi shu rtsa drug pa'ang bshad pa la kha cig nor bar sems mod kyi/ de tsam dang rags rtsis kyi dbang du mdzad pa yin pas brgya nyer lnga dang mi 'gal la/ bde mchog gi zhal bzhi la dbyibs dang nyams tha dad sbyor ba dang*/ phyogs skyong dang drag po'i gza' la sogs pa rnams la/ thal mo dgu pa dang brgyad pa bgo bsha' mdzad pa dang*/ ro langs zhal tshad bcu gnyis par mdzad pa sogs ni/ rnam grangs de ltar byas na/ tshul dang mi mthun pa med la/ de phyin ri mo mkhan rnams tshugs sbyong ba la mkho bar dgongs nas de ltar bshad pa yin gyi/ mtha' cig tu nges par slob dpon de'i bzhed pa yang ma yin no/ /'grel pa 'di dang*/ kṛ ya sa mutstsa nas bshad pa'i cha tshad rnams phal cher 'dra zhing*/ snga ma'i 'bru bshad rgyud kyi tshig don la ma zhugs pa'ang*/ paṇḍi ta rang nyid mi mkhas pa'i skyon ma yin gyi/ dus de tsam na ma ga dha dang*/ bal po'i yul gyi ri mo mkhan rnams la ji ltar grags pa de ltar dpyad pa med par bkod pa yin no/

/lugs de shes par 'dod na 'grel pa de nyid dang kri ya sa mutstsar shes par bya dgos mod/ kho bo cag ni de dag gi 'dod pa ji lta ba bzhin te/ rang lugs la mi 'dod pas lugs de rgyas par mi 'chad do/ /da ni dpal dus kyi 'khor lo las ji ltar 'byung ba dgod par bya ste/ rgyal ba'i bdag po'i gtsug tor nas ni mdzod spu'i dbus su byed dang bcas pa nyi ma'i sor du 'gyur/ /de nas mgrin pa'i chu skyes de bzhin snying ga dang ni de nas lte gsang chu skyes de bzhin no/ /zhabs kyi mthil dang rje ngar brla dang dpyi yang ma nu de nyid de nyid rig byed rnams kyi ste/ /brang phyed phyed bcas nyi mas rang dpung dpung lag rnams ni mkha' mig rgyal po nyi ma'i tshad kyis so/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga lhag pa'i brgya phrag gang zhig dus dang dgu yi mi rnams kyi ni 'jig rten tshad/ /rig byed phyed dang bcas pa'i gzhi dang chu gter chu gter phyed dang bcas pa'i rig byed rig byed kyis/ /gtsug tor mgo bo 'og tu 'gyur te rgyal ba'i bdag po'i dpal ldan dpral ba dag dang shangs dang ni/ /shangs kyi 'og tu skos sko'i mtha' dang de nas mgrin pa dag te mgrin pa'i rtsa ba'i chu skyes dbus/ /de nas snying ga lte ba gsang bar mi'i bdag po byed bcas nyi ma rnams kyi rim pas 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'dir nyi ma zhes pa bcu gnyis dang de nyid ces pa nyi shu rtsa lnga dang*/ ma nu zhes pa bcu bzhi dang*/ rgyal po ni bcu drug dang*/ mkha' mig ces pa nyi shu dang*/ dus dang dgu ni dgu bcu go drug dang*/ rig byed dang chu gter ni bzhi'i ming yin par shes par byas la/ rgyal ba'i bdag po'i sogs kyi don ni/ mdzod spu'i dbus zhes pa mdzod spu'i sa gzhi'i mas mtha' ste/ gtsug tor nas mdzod spu'i mtha' dang*/ de nas mgrin pa'i mtha' dang*/ de nas snying ga'i mtha' dang*/ de nas gsang ba'i 'khor lo'i bar rnams la re re bzhin sor phyed bcas bcu gnyis te phyed dang bcu gsum re'o/

/ zhabs mthil sor bcu bzhi ste/ 'di sku'i dpangs la mi bgrong*/ rje ngar dang brla la so sor nyer lnga re dang*/ zhabs mgo dang dpyi la sor bzhi re rnams gzhung tshig gis gsal bar bstan cing*/ 'grel pas kha bkang ba la/ zhabs mgo'i dpangs la sor phyed bsnan cing*/ pus mo la sor bzhi yang kha bkang nas/ de ltar na sor mo brgya dang nyi shu rtsa lnga'o/ /thad kar phyag brkyang ba'i 'dom gyi dbang du byas na/ thugs ka'i dbus nas dpung pa'i mtshams su phyed bcas bcu gnyis/ bar lhu la nyi shu/ phyag dar la bcu drug /phyag mgo la bcu gnyis/ 'khrig ma dang gru mo'i tshig la sor re re bsnan cing*/ de nyid g.yas g.yon du nyis 'gyur gyi bsgres pas brgya dang nyi shu rtsa lnga'o/ /rig byed phyed dang bcas pa zhes sogs kyi don ni/ gtsug tor la bzhi/ mgo bo'i 'og ste thod dpangs la phyed bcas bzhi/ dpral bar bzhi/ shangs la bzhi/ shangs 'og nas skos sko'i bar du phyed bcas bzhi/ mgrin pa la bzhi/ de nas snying ga man la gong du bshad pa ltar ro/ /dus dang dgu yis mi rnams kyi ni zhes pa/ mi phal pa'i tshad ni/ dpangs su sor mo brgyad cu rtsa bzhi dang*/ 'dom brkyang ba la dgu bcu go drug go /'di ni mchu dang zheng du mi mnyam la/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku ni dkyus dang zheng du mnyam mo/ /zhes pa ste rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di las/ lha sku la sor brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga pa kho na gsal bar gsungs shing*/ de nyid dkyil 'khor sogs phyi nang gi dag sbyor rgyas pa dang bcas te gsungs so/ /gshin rje gshed dmar nag gi rgyud las kyang zhal tshad brgyad pa gsungs shing*/ gzhan yang shā ri'i bus zhus pa'i mdor grags pa/ bal po'i dpe las bsgyur nges pa phyis 'gyur ba 'di las kyang*/ phal cher dus 'khor gyi 'di dang mthun par gsungs la/ kri ya sa mutstsar yang mdo 'di'i lung ci rigs pa drangs so/ /shā ri'i bus zhus pa'i mdo snga 'gyur du grags pa dang drang srong rgyun shes bu'i bstan bcos su grags pa sogs/

sngon dar pa rnams kyang dus 'khor sdom 'byung gnyis las 'byung ba dang phal cher mthun la cung zad mi mthun pa phra mo yod pa la/ phyis kyi mkhas par grags pa rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu 'gog par byed do/ /'on kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku rnams thams cad pa yin pa'i phyir/ tshad gcig kho nar nges pa'ang dka' la/ de dag rgya gar nas bsgyur ba min yang bla ste/ tshad kyi dbye ba de dag la brten nas kyang*/ bzo nyes 'gog nus shing*/ phyogs 'dir sngon gyi dus bstan pa dang 'gro phan gyi bya ba rgya cher byas pa'i phyir/ rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i 'jug par nges pas/ gzhung lugs de dag smod cing 'gog par byed pa yang dgos pa shin tu chung ste/ btang snyoms su bzhag na legs so/ /'dir smras pa/ bzo yi gnas dang sman gyi sbyor ba dang*/ /sngags kyi cho ga chos nyid zab mo ste/ /'di dag rtog ge'i rigs pas brtag bya min/ / bdag nyid sgrog dang nga rgyal spang bar rigs/ /da ni de dag gi lag len gyi rim pa cung zad bshad par bya ste/ 'dir smras pa/ gdong gi dkyus la sor mo bcu gnyis sam/ /gzhan du sor mo phyed dang bcu gsum mo/ /zhal tshad bcu gnyis dgu dang brgyad drug sogs/ /rang rang lus kyi de de'i cha dag la/ /zhal tshad ces bya skra mtshams skos sko'i bar/ /yin phyir de la gdong dang zhal tshad zer/ / mtho gang yin phyir mtho dang thal mor grags/ /cha chen zhes pa'ang 'di'o sor mo la/ /cha chung zhes grags gzhan gyi rigs 'gre yin/ /sor mo'i brgyad cha nas te bzhi cha ni/ /rkang pa zhais grags mkhas pas brda 'di sbyar/ /dang po sor mo brgya dang nyer lnga la/ /thal mo bcu pa'i tshad ni 'di yin te/ /gtsug tor sor bzhi skra gnas phyed dang lnga/ /dpral ba shangs dang mgrin pa bzhi bzhi ste/ /zhal gyi sa la phyed dang lnga ru 'dod/ /mgrin pa'i mtha' nas thugs ka'i bar dag dang*/ /de bzhin lte ba gsang bar mtho re'o/

/dpyi dang pus mo so sor cha chung bzhi/ /brla dang zhabs ni so sor zhal tshad gnyis/ /zhabs mgo phyed bcas sor mo bzhi ru bshad/ /gtsug nas gsang dang gsang nas zhabs mthil bar/ /phyed bcas drug cu re gnyis mnyam pa'i phyir/ /sku yi dpangs la brgya dang nyi shu lnga/ /thugs ka'i dbus nas mchan rtser zhal gang ste/ /bar lhur nyi shu phyag ngar bcu drug dang*/ /phyag mgo bcu gnyis 'khrig ma gru mo yi/ /tshigs la sor re bsnan cing phyogs gzhan la'ang*/ /de ltar sbyar bas brgya dang nyi shu lnga/ / rags rtsis yin te bar lhu phyag ngar gnyis/ /phyed dang nyer gcig phyed dang bcu drug ste/ /phyag mgo phyed bcas bcu gnyis tshigs la phyed/ /dpung pa'i tshigs la sor gang bsnan par bya/ /da ni nye ba'i tshad rnams bshad par bya/ /gtsug gi nor bu rgya dpangs sor mo gnyis/ /bskor ba gsum 'gyur yin te zlum po rnams/ /thad ka'i gsum 'gyur bskor ba yin par 'dod/ /gtsug tor rtsa ba cha phran bcu gnyis bskor/ /'bru'i phung po bzhin du rtse mo zhum/ /bod rnams lhung bzed kha bub 'dra bar 'dod/ /de 'dra 'phags yul bris 'bur gang la'ang med/ /dbu khyim zlum po bzhi bcu zhe lngas 'khor/ /dpral ba'i sor gsum 'og tu mdzod spu bri/ /de 'og nas bzhi g.yas g.yon nas drug nas/ /smin ma'i rtse mo 'dri ste de'i tshad/ /dkyus la sor bzhi sbom par nas gnyis so/ /mdzod spu'i 'og nas sor gnyis spangs pa yi/ /g.yas g.yon thad kar spyan gyi yas mtha' ste/ /spyan gyi grwa gnyis sor phyed dbus sor gsum/ /nag po sor gcig mthong mig lnga cha zer/ /spyan bzhug snyan gyi bu gar gtad ces 'dod/ /spyan gnyis bar du sor mo gnyis yin te/ /de dbus shangs kyi rtsa bar sor mo gcig / shangs dkyus phyed bzhi shangs gshog nas gnyis dang*/ /shangs rtse'i rgya ni sor mo phyed dang gnyis/ /ka ba sor phyed yin te bug pa dang*/ /shangs kyi 'phyar ni ji ltar 'os pa bya/

/'phyar dang mthun pa'i bug pa'i tshad byed pas/ /bod rnams tshad nges byed kyang nges par dka'/ /shangs nas mchu gny-is 'byar mtshams phyed dang gnyis/ /de nas skos sko'i rtse la'ang phyed gsum lhag khro dang 'dzum pa'i zhal la de gnyis phri/ /yas chu'i padma dkyus la sor mo gnyis/ /zheng la nas gsum de dbus nas phyed dma'/ /yas mchu dang ni zhal pad sor re'i dpangs/ /ma mchu nas lnga mchu dkyus nas res ring*/ /grwa gnyis 'dzum skyong sor re nas phyed zheng*/ /grwa 'dzum gyen du cung zad phyogs par bya/ /skos sko sor gnyis 'phyar ni sor mo bzhi/ /dpral ba'i dkyus ni sor mo brgyad dam bcu/ /snyan zheng sor gnyis snyan dkyus phyed dang lnga/ /smin dbus snyan gyi rtse mo mnyam zhes 'dod/ /snyan shal sor bzhi las ni mi thung ste/ /snyan gyi thad ka'i zhal zheng sor bcu gnyis/ kha cig bcu gcig 'dod ste nyams dang sbyar/ /snyan gnyis bar du mdun la nyi shu dang*/ /rgyab la bcu bzhi snyan 'phyar phyed dang gnyis/ /mgrin pa zlum rgyas zheng ni sor brgyad yin/ /ri mo dang po sor gyi bzhi gsum la/ /gnyis pa cha chung rkang bcas gsum pa ni/ /de bas lhag pa ji ltar mdzes pa bri/ /mgrin 'khor sor mo nyi shu rtsa bzhi yin/ /mgrin pa'i mtha' nas phrag pa thal mo gcig /segs la dpung pa'i mgo nas mchan rtser drug /de nas nu bar drug ste phrag gong nas/ /mtshan rtse'i bar la sor mo dgu ru 'dod/ /mthur phyag rnams la dpung mgo'i sa la bzhi/ /dpung lhu phyag ngar dkyus tshad sbom sar skor/ /'khrig mar phyed dang bcu'i bcu gcig ste/ /bri cha skor ba'i gsum cha yin par 'dod/ /phyag mthil dkyus dang smad zheng bdun yin te/ /stod zheng cha chung lnga ru bya ba yin/ /gung mo'i tshad ni sor mo lnga yin no/ /mdzub mo de yi sen rtsar sleb pa dang*/ /srin lag de las sor phyed kyis ring zhing*/ /gsum po skye sa mtho dman phal cher mnyam/

/mthe chung srin lag de las sor phyed dma'/ /rtse mos srin lag tshigs gsum pa ru sleb/ /mthe bong mdzub mo las ni sor gsum gyi/ /skye sa dma' zhing mdzub mo'i sum char sleb/ /'theb tshigs dang po 'khrig mtshams nas sor gcig /tshigs gsum rim pas nang ma'i sum cha dag /phyi ma phyi ma rnams la rim bzhin dman/ /sor mo rnams la dkyus kyi sum cha ni/ /spangs pas rtsa ba skor zhing rtse mo ni/ /sum cha spangs pa de yi phyed kyis skor/ /'khrig ma nas ni mthe bong skye mtshams bar/ /sor bzhi yin te rtsa skor srid kyang bzhi/ /gung mo'i rus tshigs 'og ma'i phyed du sleb/ /mchan khung rtse nas rtse bar mdun rgyab gnyis/ /nyer bzhi mchan 'og g.yas g.yon sor mo brgyad/ /nu rdog nas bzhi nu bar mtho re yin/ /de thad mdun rgyab gnyis la nyi shu gcig /g.yas g.yon logs la bcu gnyis de 'og tu/ /sor bzhi'i mtshams na shar nub nyi shu dang*/ /lho byang bcu ste sked mtshams chos kyi sor/ /lte ba'i sa cha'i rtse nas sor bzhi'i 'og /lte khung g.yas 'khyil zlum po sor gcig go /g.yas g.yon sta zur rtse mnyam bcu dgu ste/ /gsang ba'i sa la nyi shu bzhi'am lnga/ /'dom bar gru gsum ngos re sor bcu ste/ /thad kar gzhal na dkyus la sor brgyad do/ /sked mtshams 'og nas zhal gang gsang bar reg /de nas sor gsum bor bar rdo rje skye/ /gsang rdor dkyus dang skor ba sor drug yin/ /nor bu sor gnyis yu ba sor bzhi'o/ / chags bral sku dang zhi ba yab kyang la/ /sbubs su nub phyir yid kyis bsam par zad/ /las su rung na brgyad dgu bcu la sogs/ khro bo 'ga' la bcu gnyis dgos pa'ang yod/ /'bras bu'i zheng la bzhi ste 'phred dkyus lnga/ /dpyi dang 'doms kyi dpangs gnyis phan tshun mnyam/ /'phongs tshos sor brgyad zlum po dpangs la gsum/ /brla'i rtsa ba zlum po cha chen gcig /gung la phyogs te dbus thad bu ga'i grangs/

/rje ngar sbom sar thub pa'i grangs yin te/ /long bur mda' dang zhabs mthil bcu bzhi'o/ /mthil gyi mgor drug dbus su dbang po dang*/ /rting par rig byed 'di gsum zheng du yin/ /'on kyang phyed phyed phri na legs par mthong*/ /mtheb mdzub gnyis mnyam cha chung mig gi grangs/ / skye mtshams dbang gis mdzub mo cung zad ring*/ /gzhan gsum mi bdag nor dang klu chas dman/ /mthe bong sboms su sor mo lnga yis skor/ /gzhan rnams sbom sa rang rang dkyus kyi skor/ /'on kyang phyag dang zhabs kyi sor mo rnams/ / sboms su nges pa med pas ci mdzes bya/ /mthe bong skye mtshams zhabs dpangs sor gnyis te/ /rting pa 'phags pa phyed kyis dman pa'i mig /zhabs mgo skyes pa'i mtshams las phyed kyis dma'/ /phyag zhabs mthil rnams 'khor los mtshan pa dang*/ /rus tshigs rtsa phran 'bar 'bur mi mngon pa/ /byin gyis phra zhing byin gyis sbom pa ste/ /cha chen cha chung tshad du nges pa yi/ /thur ma'i shing gis gzhal nas snyoms par bri/ /bud med rgya dpangs mnyam pa'i nges pa med/ /'di dang mtshungs pa lha mo'i khyad par ni/ /gtsug tor spangs shing thor dpangs skos sko dang*/ /thugs ka lte ba'i sor phyed bzhi phri nas/ /sor gnyis po de lte ba man la bsnan/ /mchan rtse'i rgya la sor mo nyer gnyis bya/ /nu ma'i thad du sor mo bcu dgu bya/ /nu 'og bco brgyad sked pa zhal gang ngam/ /yang na bcu gsum tsam bya lte ba'i thad/ /nyer gcig gsang ba'i thad kar nyer drug ste/ / gsang ba'i 'khor lo'i mtshams nas sor gsum na/ /chu skyes dkyus su sor bzhi mchu la gcig /sha 'bur dpangs su sor gcig zheng du gsum/ /brla sha'i sbom sa sked par mnyam pa ste/ /de nyid dbus su sor mo drag po'i grangs/ /'phongs tshos rgya dpangs sor gang tsam re skyed/ /nu phrag sor gcig nu ma'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /gza' 'am dbyig gam rtsa yi grangs rnams so/

/zhal tshad bcu gnyis pa zhes bya ba la/ /gdan dang thor tshugs zhal tshad re re bsnan/ /zer yang thor tshugs gtsug tor steng du ni/ /mtho gang bsnan na ha cang rings par 'gyur/ /gtsug tor nang du chud pa'i mtho gang ni/ /sor mo brgyad las lhag pa med na yang*/ /lo zla'i ngo la lo zlar bgrong pa bzhin/ /bcu gnyis yin zhes tha snyad gsungs par zad/ /sor brgyad nas rtsams sor ni bcu gnyis par/ /thor tshugs dkyus ni ji ltar 'os pa dang*/ /gdan gyi dpangs la'ang gcig tu nges pa med/ 93༈ da ni cha tshad gnyis pa bshad pa la/ /sor mo brgya dang nyi shu pa yi tshad/ /dkyus dang zheng la sor phyed bcu bcu bor/ /gzhan ni sngar bshad kho na yin par shes/ /tshad 'dis lha mo 'dri na thod khyim dang*/ /mgrin pa snying ga sked pa'i gnas dag las/ /sor phyed re re phri nas lto bar bsnan/ /'di yang gzhan ni thams cad sngar dang mtshungs/ /cha chen bdun pa'i lha zhes grags pa ni/ / thal mo bcu pa gdan la bzhugs na yin/ /gdan la cha chen phyed dang gnyis dang ni/ /dpyi sor bzhi dang gtsug gi nor bu bsnan/ /zer mod 'phongs tshos dpangs la sor mo gnyis/ /skye bar 'gyur ba bsnan pa'i tshad du nges/ /rdo rje'i skyil krung rting bar sor bzhi ste/ /pus mo'i mtha' la cha bzhi sor brgyad do/ /sta zur mtshams bcas nas pus rtse'i thur shing bar/ /bcu bdun tsam yin lha nga'i dpangs la bdun/ /de yis mas mtha' nas bzung brla rtsa yi/ /yas mtha'i thur shing bar la bco lnga yod/ /skyil krung 'phrad mtshams nas ni gtsug tor mthar/ /mtho lnga sor drug 'di dag ri mo'i dpang*/ /brla sha skye mtshams lta zur nyi shu drug /sems skyil rol stabs la sogs nyams dang sbyar/ /'gying dang brkyang bskum skyil krung zheng tshad sogs/ /'phel 'grib ji ltar dgos pa'ang rigs pas dpyad/ /༈ cha tshad gsum pa 'di ltar shes bya ste/ /thal mo dgu pa zhal ras thugs ka dang*/ /lte ba gsang gnas bar du cha chen re/

/thod dpangs mgrin pa bol gong pus mor gsum/ /dpyi bzhi brla dang byin par nyer gnyis re/ /de ltar thal mo phyed dang lnga lngar 'gyur/ /brang gi dbus nas mchan khung sor mo bcu/ /bar lhu bco brgyad phyag ngar bcu bzhi ste/ /bcu gnyis phyag mgo de ltar lnga bcu bzhi/ /g.yas g.yon dbye bas sor mo brgya dang brgyad/ /thor tshugs dpangs su sor mo brgyad par bya/ /brang zheng sog mig gnyis par sor bcu dgu/ /thod zheng bcu dgu snyan gnyis bar bcu gcig /shangs zheng sor gnyis zhal dkyus phyed dang bzhi/ /snyan zheng phyed gnyis mgrin zheng sor mo bdun/ / mchan khung rtse nas phrag dpangs de dang mnyam/ /dpung pa'i zheng du sor lnga nas tshad gnyis/ /phyag ngang sbom sar sor bzhi nas gnyis te/ /cha shas phra mo rnams ni rigs pas dpyad/ /thugs ka bcu drug sked par bcu bzhi dang*/ /lte bar bco brgyad gsang bar nyer gnyis tsam/ /bzhugs tshe dpyi mig sor tshad drug gam brgyad/ /zhabs ni brla rtsa zheng du bcu gcig ste/ /pus mo'i steng brgyad byin dbus phyed dang drug /zhabs mthil dkyus la bcu'am phyed dang bcu/ /de dag yab ste lha mo rnams la ni/ /brang zheng bco lnga nu bar sor gcig ste/ /nu 'bur nu rdog dbus nas phyed bzhis skor/ /nu ma'i dpangs ni sor bzhir bya ba yin/ /thugs ka bco lnga sked par bcu gnyis te/ /sta zur rtse la bcu bdun smad nyer bzhi/ /gsang ba'i thad kar zheng la nyer lngar 'dod/ /brla'i rtsa bar zheng du bcu gnyis so/ /brang dang sked dpangs sor mo bcu gcig re/ /lto ba'i dpangs ni sor mo bcu bzhir bya/ /'on kyang 'di dang gong ma phan tshun bsres/ /ji ltar 'os par sbyar na lha mo'i tshad/ /sngon med ngo mtshar che ba legs par 'char/ /༈ cha tshad bzhi pa shin tu khros pa'i sku/ /thal mo brgyad par yongs su grags pa ni/ /dbu skra gyen du brdzes dang gdan gyi dpangs/ /bgrangs pas thal mo bcu par tha snyad mdzad/

/zhabs mgo pus mo thong dpangs rnams la bzhi/ /brla dang rje ngar rang sor bco brgyad yin/ /brla'i sum cha lto bas bkab po zhes/ /zer yang tshad ldan bzo las 'di mi 'byung*/ /zhal thugs lte gsang rnams la cha chen re/ /phyag ngar myos byed phyag mgo drag po ste/ /dpung lhu sor mo bcu bzhir bya ba yin/ /brang phyed sor mo bcu ste 'di la yang*/ /mchu zheng gab pa'i tha snyad phal cher 'dod/ shin tu khros pa'i sku la mtshan dpe dag /tshangs pa min pas chu zheng gab pa yang*/ /cig tu gos pa'i nges pa ma mthong ngo*/ /spyan zheng chung tshad sor gnyis dkyus sor gsum/ /zhal dkyus ring tshad sor drug yin zhes zer/ /snyan zheng sor gnyis mgrin zheng sor mo dgu/ /mchan 'og phrag gong sor dgu dpung pa'i dbus/ /phyed bcas bdun dang phyag ngang phyed dang bdun/ /sku yi sbom ni zhal tshad dgu pa las/ /g.yas g.yon gnyis su sor re skyed par bya/ /brla rtsar bcu gnyis byin par sor brgyad do/ /bzhugs tshe dpyi mig gdan steng brgyad dam bcu/ khro mo rnams kyang 'di las spags nas ni/ /zhal tshad dgu pa'i skabs kyi rigs 'gre'o/ /gshin rje gshed dang phyag rdor khro bo sogs/ /dkyil 'khor gtso bo'i khro rgyal rnams la ni/ /ha cang thung ba mi legs 'di nyid bsngags/ /༈ cha tshad lnga pa mtho drug ldan pa ni/ /thod dpangs sor gsum zhal ras thal mo gcig /mgrin pa sor gsum lus la thal mo gnyis/ /brla dang byin pa zhal gang pus tshigs dang*/ /zhabs mgo'i dpangs la sor gsum byed par 'dod/ /gsus pa 'phyang pas brla'i cha shas dag /ran par sgrib pa'ang ji ltar mdzes par bri/ /phyag mgo phyed brgyad phyag ngar phyed dang bcu/ /dpung lhu bcu gnyis brang phyed sor bdun no/ /zhal tshad drug pa pho nya srin po'i gzugs/ /nag po chen po la sogs tshad 'di yis/ /'bri bar bya zhes phyis kyi bod rnams 'dod/ /'di la'ang gcig tu nges pa ma mthong ngo*/

/de ltar khro bo zhal tshad drug pa dang*/ /tshogs kyi bdag po de bzhin ba ḍu ka /zer ba'i mu stegs lha dbang zhal tshad lnga/ /ratna rakṣi ta sogs rgya gar dang*/ /bal po'i mkhas pa 'ga' yis bshad pa dang*/ /bod rnams zhal tshad gsum pa'i khro bo yang*/ /yod ces 'dod pa rnam gzhag 'di dag ni/ /bod du 'gyur pa'i mdo rgyud rnams la med/ /lung du drangs pa'ang gsal po ma mthong ngo*/ /sor mo brgya dang nyer lnga de bzhin du/ /brgya dang nyi shu thal mo dgu pa dang*/ /thal mo brgyad pa zhais te lha yi tshad/ /bzhi po 'di rnams mdo rgyud las gsungs pas/ /blo ldan mkhas pas sgrims te 'bad par bya/ /rin chen srung dang dar pan a tsārya'i/ /tshig 'bru la rten dgongs don ma longs pas/ /phyi dus bod du byung ba'i dpyod ldan kun/ /dang po longs sprul gnyis pa byang sems dang*/ /gsum pa lha mo yin zhes rnam dbye 'di/ /nges pa kho nar dgos kyi gzhan min zer/ / sangs rgyas byang sems cha tshad so so ru/ /nges par khas len gshegs ma sems ma gnyis/ /cha tshad gcig tu 'dod pa nang 'gal blo/ /'khor lo sdom pa zhal tshad bcu pa la/ /phag mo zhal tshad dgu pas 'khyud pa ni/ /nges par dgos kyi gzhan du mi rung zer/ /res 'ga' gtso 'khor sku tshad mnyam pa'ang 'dod/ / 'di la yang na yum gyi sku gzugs thungs/ /yang na zhal gdong ches pa'i skyon du 'gyur/ /mo gzugs sbom zhing thung pa mtha' cig tu/ /dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yang yod ma yin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yab yum phyogs mtshungs shing*/ /byang chub sems dpa' yab yum phyogs mtshungs la/ /rgyal ba'i rigs 'khrungs rgyal ba'i sras yin pas/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'ang sangs rgyas dang mtshungs phyir/ /cha tshad gsum po 'di dag sangs rgyas dang*/ /byang sems yab yum kun la gang 'os sbyor/ /ci ste so sor sbyor ba la dga' na'ang*/ /phra sbom khyad par zhe khro la rigs pas/ /brgya dang nyer lnga sangs rgyas zhi ba dang*/

/brgya dang nyi shu he ru ka la sbyar/ /he ru ka dpal sku yi khyad par 'ga'/ /thal mo brgyad pa byed pa'i skabs kyang yod/ /spyan ma sgrol ma la sogs zhi ba mtshungs/ /rdo rje phag mo he ru kar mtshungs shing*/ /gtsug tor med kyang gtsug gi nor bu ni/ /de yi tshab tu sbyar bas mi rung med/ /gtsug tor bral zhing nu ma bha ga dang*/ /sked phra stod zhum brla dang ro smad rgyas/ /dpral ba'i zur zhum mig rgyas zer mig sogs/ /mo gzugs yin phyir lha mo rnams la dgos/ /yab rnams de las bzlog pa'i tshul du yod/ /lhag ma cha tshad rags pa mtshungs par bya/ /sems dpa' chen po rnams kyang de dag mtshungs/ /mtho dgu pa ni sems dpa' phal pa dang*/ /brgya byin la sogs 'jig rten zhi ba'i lha/ /rol pa'i khro bo he ru ka las gzhan/ /de rnams so sor rigs kyi lha mor bcas/ /de dag tshad des legs par bris gyur na/ /rnam grangs tshul gyi legs par 'gyur ba'ang yod/ /dus 'khor las gsungs mi yi cha tshad ni/ /zhal ras mtho gang brang dang sked pa dang*/ /gsus pa sor dgu brla dang rje ngar la/ /bcu drug re dang thod dpangs mgrin pa la/ /phye dang bzhi dang pus mo rkang mgo ni/ /sor gsum yin no brang phyed sor dgu dang*/ /phyed bcas dpung par bco lnga lag ngar la/ /bcu gsum lag mgo phye dang bcu gcig go /sbom phrag phal cher thal mo dgu par mtshungs/ /mi la cig tu nges pa med na yang*/ /nyan thos dgra bcom sogs la de ltar bya/ /rang rgyal thal mo dgu par bris na legs/ /so so'i 'dra 'bag rnams ni cha tshad dang*/ /mthun pa mi dgos rang rang dbyibs bzhin bya/ /gzo nyes 'gog phyir cha tshad mdzad pa ste/ /skyes bu dam pas mdzad cing bzo gnad kyi/ /'phrul la legs par byang na nges pa med/ /thub pa chu lon ma zhes grags pa bzhin/ /rdo rje gdan gyi byang chub chen po yang*/ /mgul thung dpung pa sbom zhing zhal stod rgyas/

/lha sa'i jo bo shākya mu ne la'ang*/ /cha tshad ston pa'i gzhung lugs rnams dang ni/ /rnam 'gyur cha shas 'dra min du ma mthong*/ /snyan la'ang dbyibs dang rnam 'gyur gzhan du yod/ /'phags pa'i yul du mkhas pas bzhengs pa yi/ /lugs ma rkos ma sku tshad chung ngu rnams/ /phal cher phyag sor sbom ste mi mdzes med/ /mig sngar mdzes shing mthong na dang ba 'dren/ /lhun bag chags shing gzi sbyin rgyas gyur pa'i/ /sku gzugs de ni cha shas phra mo dag cha tshad gzhung dang mthun pa min yang bla/ /lha mi'i mchod 'os 'jig rten phan bde'i rgyu/ /bzo rig rnam 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa yi/ /blo gros nyin byed kho nas ma shar bar/ /cha tshad cung zad sbyangs pa'i nga rgyal gyis/ /mkhas pa'i lag rjes khyad du gsad mi bya/ /tshugs bzang 'phrul chags rnam 'gyur zad pa med/ /tshon legs lha yul me tog mdangs 'phrog can/ /'dri ba gang de rgyal ba'i 'phrin las te/ /sa la bi shwa karma gnyis pa bzhin/ 92 /yang 'di skad ces/ khyim bya'i sgo nga til rnam pa/ /gru bzhi dang ni zlum por bcus/ /thun mong sku ni thams cad kyi/ /zhal gyi dbyibs ni rnam pa bzhi/ /skyes bu che dang lha mo yi/ khyim bya'i sgo nga til gyi dbyibs/ /zhes dang*/ khro bo rnams kyi rnam 'gyur dbyibs/ /zlum po dag dang gru bzhi ste/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don/ kri ya sa mutstsa sogs las kyang gzhan dang gzhan du bshad mod kyi/ 'di la mtha' gcig tu nges pa med na'ang*/ 'di ltar bya bar 'dod pa la/ bod rnams zhal gang gru bzhi'i zur nas gcod pa sogs la nges pa cher mi snang ste/ sgo nga'i dbyibs zhes bya ba/ steng 'og nas cung zad zhum zhing dbus rgyas pa'i ming yin la/ til gyi dbyibs ni zhal stod rgyas shing zhal smad cung zad pa sogs las bshad pa ni/ lha sku gcig 'dri ba/ bslabs pas nyams tha dad pa'i zhal bzhin bzhi shes par 'gyur pa'i phyir/ rgya bal gyi bzo bo 'ga' zhig gi de ltar byas pa ltar bkod pa yin pa spyir mi 'gal mod kyang*/

'di kho na ltar dgos pa ma yin no/ /dus 'khor la sogs pa zhal tha dad pa la nyams so so rgyud nas gsungs pa rnams ni de kho na ltar nges par dgos la/ dmigs bsal med pa rnams la ci bder byar rung yang*/ phal cher nyams 'gyur mtshungs par byed pa mang ngo*/ /spyan gyi lta stangs la 'di skad ces bya ste zheng du nas bcu dkyus la bcu bzhi ste/ 'di ni padma'i 'dab ma'i dbyibs zhes bya/ /zheng drug dkyus la nyi shu yang na ni/ /bco brgyad nya'i lto ba 'dra bar 'dod/ /zheng la sor gcig dkyus la sor mo gnyis/ /utpal 'dab ma rgyas pa lta bur 'dod/ /thub pa chen po mnyam gzhag la bzhugs na/ /zheng du nas gnyis dkyus la nas nyer bzhi/ /gzhu'i rnam pa lta bu'i spyan zhes zer/ /'di dag thams cad rang gar bzhag pa'i spyan/ /rab tu phye nas gzigs na 'di bas lhag /'di dag lha yi spyan gyi dbye ba yin/ /de dag las ud pa la yi 'dab ma lta bu ni/ spyan gyi grwa bzhug gnyis kar phra zhing dbus gdangs pa ste/ 'di la sngon dus kyi bod pa'i lha bzo ba rnams mgron bu lta bu zhes zer ro/ /pad 'dab lta bu ni spyan bzhug dang grwa zur gyi rtse ma gtogs cha mnyam du sbom pa dang*/ nya'i lto ba lta bu ni/ ring zhing sbom pa ste/ de nyid mig 'dzum du byed na 'od ma'i gzhu lta bu'o/ /thub pa sangs rgyas mnyam gzhag gi spyan/ gzhu lta bu'o zhes pa'i gzhu spyan ni rwa gzhu lta bu'o/ /de nyid gdangs pa ni pho zhi ba rnams la'o/ /nya lta bu ni lha mo zhi ba rnams la 'os shing*/ 'od ma'i gzhu lta bu g.yem ma rnams kyi mig ste mchod pa'i lha mo sogs la sbyar ba yin no/ /padma dang utpal lta bu ni zhi ma khro rnams la'o/ /shin tu khros pa'i khro bo dang khro mo'i spyan yang rnam pa gnyis su yod de/ zlum po dang gru bzhi'i rnam pa'o/ khro chen rnams zhal ches cher bgrad cing gdangs pa/ g.yal ba ltar byed pa ni/

rgya gar bal po la sogs pa'i bzo rgyun khungs ma rnams la med pas/ bod yul du phyis byung ba'o/ /de ltar na dus 'khor gyi ye shes mchod rten ma gtogs spyir stangs su mchod rten la cha tshad nges pa can gsungs pa nyung zhing*/ sku gzugs la mdo rgyud gnyis ka nas nan tan du gsungs pas/ gnas skabs phal cher du tshad dang mi 'gal ba la nan tan du bya'o/ /'dir smras pa/ sangs rgyas sku gzugs ri mor bris pa dang*/ /'bur ma'i khyad par phun tshogs legs sbyar na/ /tshe 'dir grags pa thob cing nad med la/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i 'byor pa thob pa dang*/ /gnod byed gdon gyi tshogs rnams byer bar 'gyur/ /lo legs phyugs kyang 'phel bar 'gyur ba dang*/ /'khrug pa zhi zhing tshe ring dga' ba thob/ /phyogs der bstan pa dar zhing yun ring gnas/ /skye ba gzhan du rigs bzang gzugs mdzes cing*/ /dbang po gsal la shes rab bzang por 'gyur/ /rims kyis rgyal ba'i sku mchog nges par thob/ /mthong na gzhan dag dad pa skye ba dang*/ /thos pa tsam gyi rjes su yi rang 'byung*/ /phyag dang bskor ba mchod pa smon lam sogs/ /byang chub bar gyi tshogs gnyis spel ba'i phyir/ /sems can gzhan don bla na med par 'gro/ /gsang sngags sgrub pa rnams kyi grub pa'i rdzas/ /sku gzugs mthong bas ting 'dzin mchog kyang thob/ /mchod dang bzlas pa'i zhing du 'gyur ba ste/ /'dzam gling nor gyi

: khengs （《dzaṃ》 khongs ） pa sbyin pa yang*/ /bla med byang chub rgyu ru ma nges la/ /yungs 'bru tsam gyi rgyal ba'i sku bzhengs nas/ /rims kyis byang chub mchog tu nges par gzhol/ /de ltar rgyal ba'i sku gzugs bzhengs pa ni/ /bsod nams tshogs kyi nang na mchog rab gtso/ /bstan pa 'di las phyi rol gyur pa la/ /sku gzugs mtshan nyid rnam par dag pa med/ /cha tshad phun tshogs nang pa'i khyad chos yin/ /kla klo rnams ni sku gzugs mthong na khro/ /mu stegs byed kyang mchog tu bkur ba med/ /sku gzugs mchod dang ri mor bgyis pa las/ /bsod nams rgya chen thob par rgyal bas gsungs/ /༈ da ni ri mo la mkho ba'i rnam grangs 'ga' zhig bshad par bya ste/ deng sang phal cher/ sangs rgyas rab byung gi cha byad la sprul sku dang*/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i cha byad la longs sku zhes zer mod/ gnyis ka la gnyis ka yod pas brda chad de mi legs la/ bde mchog sogs drang srong khros pa yin zer nas shin tu skem par 'dod pa yang mi legs so/ /des na rab byung gi rnam pa la chags bral gyi sku dang*/ zhi ba rgyan can la 'khor los sgyur ba'i cha byad dang*/ zhi ba rgyan med la drang srong gi cha byad dang rigs ngan gyi cha byad gnyis yod cing*/ bde dgyes dus 'khor sogs he ru ka sangs rgyas khro bo dang*/ thal mo dgu pa'i khro bo la rol pa'i khro bo phal pa'am/ sems dpa'i khro bo zhes bya ba dang*/ 'jam dbyangs dang spyan ras gzigs dang kun tu bzang po sogs nye ba'i sras brgyad lta bu sems dpa' mchog dang*/ de dag gi sgos kyi 'khor zhi ba pho mo la byang sems phal pa dang*/ dmar nag 'jigs gsum rta mgrin la sogs pa khro bo'i rgyal po dang*/ nag po chen po dang*/ lha mo re ma ti la sogs pa pho nya phyag brnyan zhes tha snyad sbyor dgos la/ drang srong khros pa zhes pa gzhung tshad ldan las ma bshad kyang*/ drang srong ni sangs rgyas kyi mtshan gyi rnam grangs yin pas/

sangs rgyas khro bo zer ba'i don yin la/ gzhan khro bo la gnod sbyin khros pa dang*/ srin po khros pa dang*/ gshin rje khros pa sogs kyi dbye ba byas nas nyams tha dad par dgos par bod rnams 'dod kyang nges pa ma mthong ngo*/ /gzhan yang rdo rje'i skyil krung ni zhabs brla steng du bsnol ba g.yon pa g.yas pas mnan pa yin la/ sems dpa'i skyil krung ni/ gcig gi byin pa'i steng du gcig shos kyi zhabs mgo bzhag pa dang*/ padma'i skyil krung ni zhabs mthil mnyam par sbyar ba dang*/ g.yas brkyang dang g.yon brkyang ni mtho lngar brkyang pa zhes 'dod kyang 'di la nges pa med de/ sngon dus bzhengs pa'i rgya bal gyi lha khung ma 'ga' zhig mtho bdun du brkyang ba yang mthong ngo*/ /gang bskum pa'i phyogs 'greng thabs su 'dri bar mi bya ste/ brla ni thad ka'am segs su 'dri gos la/ rje ngar ni thur ltas su bris na legs so/ /mnyam pa'i stabs ni/ zhabs mgo gnyis la bar mtshams med pa ltar bshad kyang nges pa med mod/ bar mtho gang las che ba mi bya zhing mnyam par bzhengs pa yin la/ sa ga'i stabs ni bar thag khru gang tsam bzhag nas/ zhabs mgo g.yas g.yon tu bstan pa dang*/ rol stabs la gnyis las bzhengs pa ni zhabs gcig drang por btsugs pa'i bol gong la/ gcig shos kyi rting pa gtad pa yin cing bzhugs pa ni skyil krung phyed pa dang phal cher 'dra ba las/ zhabs gcig gi sor mo la gcig shos kyi rting pa dang byin pa'i mtshams gtad pa tsam mo/ /bzhengs bzhugs gnyis ka la yang g.yas g.yon gyi rol stabs gnyis ka yod do/ /zlum po'i stabs ni rting pa gnyis kyi bar du mtho gang sogs ji ltar 'os pa bzhag nas/ pus mo gnyis g.yas g.yon du 'bur 'bur po ngang ba'i gshog pa ltar byas pa'o/ /de nyid la 'phongs sa la ma reg tsam du smad pa ni rus sbal gyi rkang stabs so/ /de nyid las pus mo gnyis mdun du cung zad phyogs pa ni bya rog gi 'dug stangs so/

/rkang pa phyogs gcig pus mo 'bur ba dang*/ phyogs gcig rgyab tu btegs nas lus cung zad mdun du 'dud pa ni/ bung ba'i rkang stabs so/ /taṇḍa ba'i rkang stabs ni/ deng sang gar stabs su grags pa ste/ 'di la gcig brkyang pa'i brla la gcig shos kyi rkang mthil sbyor bar bshad pa ni/ mi rnams gar byed pa'i dbang du byas pa yin te/ rdeg 'chos par gyur gyi dogs pas so/ /lha sku 'dri ba la de ltar mi mdzes te/ des na sngon bris 'bur khungs ma rnams las 'byung ba bzhin/ zhabs gcig gi sor rtse'am brang pas gdan mnan cing*/ cig shos kyi zhabs sor byin pa'i dbus dang*/ rting pa brla'i phyogs la bstan kyang*/ brla dang rting pa ma reg par bya zhing*/ zhabs gnyis kar lhod nyams su byas pas shin tu mdzes shing bag chags par 'gyur ro/ /bung ba'i dra ba dang rkang gcig pa zhes gar gyi gzhung tshad ldan las tha dad par gsungs kyang*/ 'dir 'phags yul dang bal po'i bzo bo rnams la sngon dus grags pa ltar bkod cing*/ gzhan yang mi'i lus kyi gar byed tshul dang*/ lha'i rnam pa 'god tshul mi 'dra ba'i skabs yod pas/ mtha' gcig tu gang yig dang bstun mi dgos so/ /sher phyin ser mo phyag bzhi ma dang*/ khro gnyer spyan ma sogs dmigs bsal gsungs pa'i skabs ma gtogs/ lha mo rnams la ral lcog dang gar zhwa lta bu'i thor tshugs kyi dprog zhu mi bya ste/ dbu skra g.yas sam g.yon du bcings pa dang gnyis kar bcings pa dang*/ ltag par bcings pa dang phyed bcings phyed grol la sogs pa bya la/ dpangs su ji ltar ring yang sor lnga las lhag pa mi bya zhing*/ rgya khyon cher skyed de zlum zlum po dang sgor sgor por bya'o/ /yang na 'phyang zhing bcings pa zhes bya ba/ rtsa ba ma bcings shing rtse mo rnams rgyab tu bcings pa/ rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ mthong cha'i dbang du byas nas/ dpung pa g.yas g.yon gyi mthar mngon pa ste/

sngon gyi mkhas pa'i lag rjes la blta'o/ /gsang 'dus 'jam rdor la sogs pa rang 'dra'i yum du bshad pa rnams la/ rang 'dra yin pa'i phyir thor tshugs dgos sam snyam na mi dgos te/ bud med kyi rtags yin pa'i phyir/ nu 'bur dang 'dra'o/ /gzhan yang lha rgyan ldan rnams la/ phyis kyi bod rnams 'dri ba : lta （《dzaṃ》 lha ） rgyan sbom zhing rags la mang bas thag thug tu 'gyur ba mi 'dri ste/ sbom phra dang mang nyung 'tsham par bri'o/ /de la rin po che'i dpraug zhu ni/ bang rim rim pa gsum mam bzhi dang ldan pa/ bang rim re re bzhin rtse phran mang du yod pa/ rtse mo rdo rje'am rin po ches brgyan pa/ mgo la zhwa ltar gon rgyu yin pas/ rtse phran can la dbu skra thor lcog mi mthong zhing*/ dbu skra grol ba'i zar bu dpung par 'phyang ba sogs ni ma bkag go /ral pa'i thor tshugs can la dbu rgyan ma gtogs dpraug zhu 'di med la/ dbu rgyan yang rtse phran gyi rnam pa ma 'chugs pa dgos kyi/ pa tra dang nor bu la sogs pa'i ci yin med pa'i zar zir mi 'dri zhing*/ phyag gdub dpung gdub snyan rgyan mgul rgyan sogs go bar zad la/ se mo do ni sku'i sked pa tsam du sleb pa'i 'phreng ba yin la/ 'di la do shal byed pa zer/ rin po che'i do shal la phal cher phrag shal du bya ba dang*/ ske la dkon pa'ang yod la/ rkang gdub byin par 'ching ba dang*/ bol gong du 'ching ba gnyis yod pa la lha mo rnams la g.yer ka'i phreng ba can du byed/ 'og pag zhes pa ska rags kyi rgyan yin cing*/ de las dra phyed 'phyang ba smad rgyan du grags pa yin na'ang*/ bal po dang bod pa rnams gar byed pa'i smad rgyan khrom shogs rgyang rgyag lhur len pa ltar dra phyed mthug la ring pa 'di lta bu mi bya ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi dra phyed 'dra ba bya la/ rus rgyan yin na srog shing rus 'phreng ring ba rtse mo la dril bu g.yer kha dpyangs pa dang*/

rin po che'i rgyan la ni 'og pag nyid la dril chung 'phyang ba yin no/ /de la sngon gyi ri mo ba rnams na re/ rna rgyan mgul rgyan lag gdub gsum/ /brji brji 'dra cig 'dod pa yin/ / dbu rgyan dpung rgyan rkang gdub skyed/ /yang yang 'dri cig 'dod pa yin/ /zhes so/ /phyag mtshan gyi khyad par la/ ral gri khru gang ba sogs cha tshad nges pa can rgya gzhung 'ga' re nas bshad pa yod kyang*/ nges par dgos pa ma yin la/ ngos 'dzin cung zad bshad na/ dang po'i rdo rje ni rdo rje dmar po phyogs kyi rwa bzhi dbus rwa la en ma reg tsam yin la/ khro bo'i rdo rje ni rwa bzhi po shin tu kha 'gyes pa yin cing*/ gang ni dbyug pa dkar po ring po rtse mo tog can rtse sbom po zhig yin la/ skye ba lnga pa'i dung ni dung dkar g.yas 'khyil lo/ /mdung dang ral gri la sogs pa mang po zhig rgya bod gnyis bkod pa mi mthun yang*/ rang rang lugs bzhin byas pas 'gal ba med/ chu gri zhes pa gri thung yin pa/ so gcig pa dang so gnyis pa ste rigs gnyis rgya gar nas 'byung la/ bod lugs ltar na/ rkang gri'o/ /shaka ti ni mdung so dgra sta kha yod pa'i mdung thung yin la/ bi rdi pa la'i 'phang mdung ni rtse mo rno ba mdung so 'dra ba/ yu ba la rma bya'i sgro phon can no/ /gtun shing ni shing sked nyag rtse gnyis zlum pa 'bras brdung ba sogs byed pa'o/ /rdo rje rtse gcig pa zhes pa la rigs gnyis te e ka sū tsi ka badzra zhes pa ni/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyogs kyi rwa bzhi bcad pa lta bu dang*/ ka ṇā ya zhes pa mdung thung ngam mdungam phyed pa'am/ lcags mdung rdo rje rtse gcig pa zhais bsgyur ba rnams don gcig la/ g.yul 'thab pa'i tshe glang po che'i mgo bor bsnun pa la dgos pa ste/ yu ba 'do gang tsam la stod smad gnyis kar du zlum po 'khor lo 'dra ba'i dkyil nas mdung so khru gang tsam pa/ rtsa ba sbom zhing rtse mo byin gyis phra ba/

gzong kha yod pa'o/ /thod tshal gyi kha phor dang*/ tsa sha ka dang*/ bshor thod rnams don gcig ste/ /rtse thod bregs pa sngags rnying ma pa'i bhan dha 'dra ba'o/ kha ṭwāṃ ga la/ lha dbang phyug chen po'i phyag mtshan la rtse gsum gyis mtshan pa'ang bshad/ gzhan spyi ldog nas rdo rje dang mi mgo sogs kyis mtshan pa'i dbyug pa yin pas/ sngags pa blun po dang*/ rtogs ldan blun po 'ga' re'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ thug lcags rtse gsum la 'dod pa shin tu 'khrul lo/ /ḍa ma ru ni sked g.yogs dang dra ba med pa'i yu ba can nam/ dra ba can la sked g.yogs rgyab pa yu ba med pa ste/ dar 'phan 'dogs pa ni bod kyi mdzes chos te/ yi dam gyi lha chen po'i sku brnyan gyi phyag mtshan la ni mi dgos la/ bzo rtsed dang bod kyi bla ma sogs la bya'o/ /rdza rnga ni zo dpangs khru gnyis tsam yod na/ dbus kyi ldir ba'i cha la bskum khru tsam/ kha gnyis kyi rgya la rkang gang ngam/ de las chung tsam yod pa/ zo dpangs la cha gsum du btang ba'i mtshams nas/ thi gu btags te ske la gon pa'o/ /rnga zlum ni ku phor la rnga lpags g.yogs pa lta bu bsham du bu ga cung zad yod pa/ rnga bo che ni bod kyi mchod lnga 'dra ba las zod dpangs mtho ba zhig go /rnga pa ṭa ha ni ḍa ma ru ltar sked nyag la dra ba g.yogs pa zo dpangs kyi phyed kha'i rgya la yod pa'o/ /rnga ḍha ka zhes bya ba ni zom gyi kha la rnga lpags phub pa 'dra ba/ 'og tu bu ga cung zad dang bcas pa/ g.yas g.yon du lung yod pa ste/ zangs las byas pa'o/ /phe ṭa ka zhes bya ba ni/ ral gri so gnyis ma 'dra rung la 'khyog po'o/ /phub zlum ni bse phub tu grags pa yin la/ phub zlum yu ba can no/ /lhung bzed kha bregs pa 'dra ba'i lag phub ste/ nang du yu ba 'phreng ka lta bu yod pa'o/ /phub ring ni gru bzhi nar thabs can ni/ bho kang ni zangs dung ngo*/ /de dag la sogs pa mkhas pa la 'dri zhing mkhas pa'i lag rjes la blta bar bya ste/

mtha' dag brjod kyi mi lang ngo*/ /yang de dag la sangs rgyas byang sems chags bral gyi rnam pa can dang bya spyod lugs kyi sku gzugs 'dri ba'i tshe/ gtsang sbra dang bcas shing*/ bsnyen gnas yang dag par blang ba dang*/ gsang sngags nang gi lha 'dri ba ni/ ri mo mkhan dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig gi ma nyams pa gal che zhing*/ rgyud nas bshad pa'i dngos grub sgrub pa'i rten bris sku'i cho ga bzhin du 'grub na ches legs la/ de ltar ma 'grub kyang mtshams bcad de/ skye bo phal cher gyis mi mthong ba dang*/ mchod gtor dam rdzas dang bcas pa yang yang phul na shin tu legs par 'gyur ro/ / mtha' dag srid dang zhi ba'i bde skyid ni/ /ma lus sangs rgyas rjes su dran las byung*/ /gang na rgyal ba'i sku gzugs legs bzhengs pa/ /de nas sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa yod/ /cha tshad rnam par bzhag pa mdor bsdus tsam/ /dag gsal bzung du bde ba brjod 'di yin/ /chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ /chos nyid zab mo gnas la gzhol bar shog /dpal sdom pa 'byung pa dang*/ dus kyi 'khor lo rgyud don phyin ci ma log pa la bod phal pa rnams kyi zer sgros ma slad par/ sku gzugs kyi cha tshad mdo tsam brjod pa bde skyid 'byung gnas zhes bya ba 'di yang*/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā tha la/ ri mo'i 'du byed pa 'ga' zhig snga mo nas bskul ba yod pa dang*/ nye bar lha bzo snying snying gis bskul nas nags rgyal gyi dben gnas su nges par brjod pa'o/ /bkra shis par shog/ // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/rgyal ba'i sku gzugs kyi cha tshad bstan pa bde skyid 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs/ - PAGE 492 -- PAGE 491 -- PAGE 467 -
